messages:
morgan: Heads up — found a case where quota attribution in the console shows the org/project from the service account instead of the effective project used for billing. Users see the wrong project on the usage dashboard :confused:
sam: Can you repro? example request + headers?
morgan: Yep, small reproducible snippet: `POST /v1/generate` with `Authorization: Bearer sa-xxxx` and `X-Origin-Project: proj-frontend`. Router picks sa-owner for billing.
morgan: Full headers we send: ```
Authorization: Bearer sa-abc123
X-Origin-Project: proj-frontend
X-Request-ID: track-123
```
devon: That's the current behavior: router assigns billing/project from the token's principal when token type == service_account. We did that to prevent spoofed origin headers but it makes delegated SA calls unattributed to the caller project.
joyce: Oof — that will confuse customers who expect project-level budgets to follow the originating project, not the SA owner.
anita: We also have enterprise contracts relying on owner-project SLOs. Changing attribution might surface billing delta for some customers. Need a safe rollout plan.
devon: Proposal: add a new effective_identity resolution order: 1) validated X-Origin-Project if token exchange proof exists, 2) exchange-derived project claim, 3) token principal fallback. Add opt-in flag per org to prefer origin header.
morgan: For safety we should emit telemetry signals before we flip. Suggested metrics: `auth.event_origin_project`, `auth.effective_project`, `auth.token_type`, `auth.route_decision` with tags `validated:true|false`.
joyce: I can wire a temporary dashboard showing mismatches (origin != effective) and a histogram by org. That'll help sales/customer-success catch surprised accounts.
devon: Also add an audit log entry per request: `resolved_identity: {source: origin_header|exchange|token, project: proj-x}`. Keep logs for 30 days behind feature flag.
anita: Rollout plan idea: 1) collect telemetry for 2 weeks, 2) expose opt-in console toggle per org, 3) run canary for 5% traffic of opting orgs, 4) flip on by default after 4 weeks.
morgan: Agreed. Also need a small console UX: in routes/quota view show both "Effective project" and "Token owner project" with tooltip explaining rules.
joyce: I'll draft the copy + mockups tomorrow. Want a short name for the feature? "Effective Identity Attribution"?
devon: Sounds good. I'll start the router change behind a config flag and add the metrics. infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2891 — add telemetry + feature flag for effective identity attribution.
morgan: Thanks — ping me once the dashboard is available and I'll run a quick sweep on sample tenants.
anita: And I'll notify account leads about the upcoming opt-in so no surprises.
joyce: Filing the UX ticket now.
morgan: sweet. Nothing urgent to block release, just want telemetry first :thumbsup:
